project.name: HSMSimulator
project.description: Local stand-in for a SafeNet Luna HSM, for developing any Spring Boot service that loads the Luna JCE provider. Not a real HSM - for development use only, when there is no network path to the actual Luna appliance. Not affiliated with or endorsed by SafeNet/Thales; it only reimplements the small slice of the JCA Provider/KeyStore contract such a service calls, under the same class name, so it can be dropped in via config alone.
